notes: Estimated Flex geometry and mass from supplied build diagrams: 430 x 400 mm footprint, 330 mm track, 6.5 kg. Replace with measurements.
Powered wheels modeled as 4 inch (101.6 mm) omnis; check actual effective rolling diameter. external_ratio means motor revolutions per wheel revolution.
Field uses nominal 140.5 inch wall-to-wall interior; 600 mm tile pitch is illustrative and edge tiles are trimmed by perimeter.
Green 200 RPM is specified by VEX. 1.05 Nm is an ideal gear-ratio estimate from the documented 2.1 Nm red100 RPM stall torque.
All friction, motor response, wheel inertia, GPS noise/delay/dropout settings are tunable approximations, not measured VEX specifications.
Robot collision shape is a fixed rectangle centered at the drive turning center; raised/folded mechanisms are not separately simulated.
Physical GPS mount is independent of Gps(...) code offsets: wrong code offsets produce biased simulated readings. Ports remain 9, 10 and 18.
